title: Kinetic evolution of ZrO2-modified silicate-based glass sealants during sintering and crystallization in planar solid oxide fuel cells
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,7355-7370
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA08813E, Paper
Open Access

Shuai Yuan, Haozhen Li, Hao Shi, Yuxuan Fei, Hengyong Tu, Chao Ma, Lei Zhu, Zhen Huang
ZrO2 particle size and concentration regulate sintering and crystallization kinetics of glass composite sealants. 200 nm ZrO2 forms a RPF structure, enhances heterogeneous nucleation, refines diopside grains, and yields compatible CTE with SOFC.
